results.exact_delta_review: Pass: excellentiam verbi to divinitatem Filii; B. to beatus; confessor gloriosus to episcopus constanter; confiteri to profiteri. These are genuine finite changes, not typography. Modern AP417 complete prayer and cue were directly read.

whole_expression.reason: The independently printed old whole unit already contains the particular Hilary-centered relative clause and the paired request to understand fittingly and confess truly. The changed doctrinal nouns, factual episcopal title, steadfastness adverb and profession verb preserve that complete arrangement. Taken together they specify the inherited prayer’s subject and mode without a new episode, image or petition sequence. The basis is the old complete expression plus this specific conventional restatement, not merely the availability of its ingredients.
whole_expression.contrary_argument_weighed: The changes deliberately sharpen the theological object and recast glorious confession as episcopal steadfastness. They cannot support historical human-English transfer and are not proven old exact wording. Nevertheless the substantive theological difference does not by itself defeat the finite argument that the new verbal contribution is ordinary description within an independently established complete prayer; under1(6) I favor this exact fresh study body.
whole_expression.scope: No precedent for any other doctor prayer or generic four-substitution allowance.

results.exact_delta_review: Pass: oves tuas to fideles tuos; Damasus life/teaching phrase to Apollinaris bishop teaching/martyrdom phrase with required grammatical recasting; eius subsequi vestigia to in mandatis tuis perseverare. whole_expression.confidence: moderate, lower source certainty than an original old facsimile
whole_expression.reason: The whole older prayer, not three isolated scraps, already gives the distinctive ordered progression from guidance on the saint-shown way of eternal salvation, through his intercession and our conduct, to being crowned with him. The modern version replaces the sheep and footsteps metaphors with plain faithful/commandment language and changes the saint’s factual mode of witness to teaching and martyrdom. Those coordinated changes materially alter meaning, but the full rhetorical progression and closing petition remain independently inherited. I find a defensible narrow study-English basis under1(6) for this conventional recasting of that entire older prayer.
whole_expression.contrary_argument_weighed: The replacement of imitation by perseverance in God’s commands is more than a name change, and the combination of changed metaphor, martyrdom and moral object could be an original modern selection. The oldpage is also unverified. I do not erase either objection: source uncertainty is expressly carried by the qualified human witness, while the expression assessment rests on the unchanged complete rhetorical sequence and nonextended ordinary replacement language. This is an affirmative exact-unit judgment, not a rule that three replacements or conventional ingredients are automatically free.
whole_expression.scope: Acceptance is for the reported older prayer as transmitted by this named human carrier and the exact reviewed English; no original1738 facsimile claim or other adaptation follows.
